nodes.summary: For groups $T$ and $Q$, $T$ is a composition factor of $Q$ when some subnormal subgroup $H$ of $Q$ maps onto $T$, that is, there is a surjective group homomorphism $H \to T$. Here $H$ is subnormal in $Q$ when there is a finite chain of subgroups $H = H_0 \le H_1 \le \dots \le H_k = Q$ in which each $H_j$ is normal in $H_{j+1}$.
nodes.title: Composition factor of a group (via subnormal subgroups)

nodes.summary: For groups $T$ and $G$, $T$ is an upper composition factor of $G$ when it is a composition factor of some finite quotient of $G$: there are a finite group $Q$ and a surjective group homomorphism $G \to Q$ such that $T$ is a composition factor of $Q$, that is, $T$ is a homomorphic image of a subnormal subgroup of $Q$.
nodes.title: Upper composition factors

nodes.summary: For every family $(T_i)_{i \in I}$ of finite non-abelian simple groups there is a group $G$ generated by $3$ elements such that a finite non-abelian simple group $Q$ is an upper composition factor of $G$ (a composition factor of some finite quotient of $G$) if and only if $Q$ is isomorphic to $T_i$ for some $i \in I$. Abelian upper composition factors of $G$ are not restricted.
nodes.title: Segal's theorem on upper composition factors, 3 generators (Kourovka Problem 11.57)

nodes.summary: The statement that for every family $(T_i)_{i \in I}$ of finite non-abelian simple groups there is a group $G$ generated by $3$ elements such that a finite non-abelian simple group $Q$ is an upper composition factor of $G$ if and only if $Q$ is isomorphic to $T_i$ for some $i \in I$. Abelian upper composition factors of $G$ are not restricted.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 11.57, 3-generator form (statement)

nodes.summary: For every family $(T_i)_{i \in I}$ of finite non-abelian simple groups there is a group $G$ generated by $63$ elements such that a finite simple group $Q$ is an upper composition factor of $G$ (a composition factor of some finite quotient of $G$) if and only if $Q$ is isomorphic to $T_i$ for some $i \in I$. In particular, no cyclic group of prime order is an upper composition factor of $G$.
nodes.title: Segal's theorem on upper composition factors, 63 generators (Kourovka Problem 11.57)
